description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling acl entry modification events in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements event application logic.

classes.name: AclEntryModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a specific event handling strategy for AclEntryModified events, extending AbstractThingEventStrategy.

methods.name: AclEntryModifiedStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for the strategy class, protected access, calls the superclass constructor.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply an AclEntryModified event to a ThingBuilder, setting permissions based on the event data.
